During a '''time period''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]], the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] cleared large areas of [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]] forest for industrial purposes. From the resulting clearance, a [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] plague afflicted the [[Species/Legends|species]], forcing them to return to the forests and forsake their industrial progress.
